Title: Hand reduced vs. do not replace until after combat

Messages.Author: Jesper Bøje
Messages.Body:
Hi all

Last time we played we ended up with a littel argument, and hope somebody
can help me out here.

Vamp a, with a raptor bleeds
Vamp b, wakes with a "Wake with..."
Combat starts

Now Vamp b may NOT replace the "Wake with..." card.
And he got his hand reduced by one card coz the raptor, but dose that mean
that he

a) Now have an effectiv hand size of 5, and must discard a card
or

/Jesper

> of the combat" seems to me that its pretty odd that it dosent then.

Because that would be a different effect - you would play Bum's Rush and draw
to replace it and then discard down to your newly-reduced hand size and then,
after the action was over, you'd draw again.

You've just introduced a "free" discard into the works.

Messages.Author: Peter D Bakija
Messages.Body:
Jesper Bøje wrote:

> Then why why why, do we have two different terms that cover the same thing??
> Why dosent Wake, Bums rush etc. "Reduce you hand size by on, for the remind
> of the combat" seems to me that its pretty odd that it dosent then. Maybe
> somnething LSJ and other should think about in the future :o)

'Cause some of them only last a varying, but short period of time, some last
forever.

Wake costs you a hand slot till the begining of your next turn ('cause Wake
is balanced that way). Raptor costs you a hand slot till the end of combat
('cause that is what Raptor does). That Ventrue guy whose name I can't
remember makes you lose a hand slot till he isn't ready any more. They all
do the same thing in some sense (make you lose a hand slot) but for a
different amount of time.

If you use a Wake (-1 hand size till your next untap) and get in combat with
an opponent with 2 Raptors (-2 hand size till end of combat) while that
Ventrue guy is ready (-1 hand size till he is no longer ready), and are
targeted by an Aggressive Tactics (-1 hand size) but you have an Elder
Library (+1 hand size), you'll have a hand size of 3 till the end of combat.
